subfiles.title: List of Papers on Japanese Merchant-Vessel and Yacht Movements
subfiles.about: An administrative index summarizes reports and instructions concerning Japanese-controlled vessels and their movements during the latter half of 1940.
subfiles.summary: Index covers Amano, Norfolk Land, Simmons, Sakura Maru, Nitiei Maru, and Omurosan Maru sightings, cargoes, and routes, Sakura Maru's reported Helgoland encounter, and a circular requiring bills-of-health reports for 4,000-ton-plus Japanese vessels, Navy-funded.

interest: Shows late-1940 U.S. surveillance of Japanese merchant and fishing vessels across Latin American and Pacific waters.
